caption: ODC1, MYCN-high versus rest. Each dot is one biological unit's log2 relative quantity (MYCN-high n = 52, rest n = 294); technical replicates are averaged within each unit and never counted as n. Bars: group mean with its 95 % confidence interval (Student's t). Quantities are normalised to the mean log2 quantity of the reference genes ALUsq(Eurogentec), HMBS, HPRT1; efficiency: LinRegPCR's mean efficiency of the amplicon on each plate; a curve counts as amplified by LinRegPCR's own call (a starting quantity was found); wells with no quantity: drop empty wells. Welch's t test on the per-unit log2 values: fold change 3.21× (95 % CI 2.15× to 4.79×), p = 2.5 × 10⁻⁷; called up under the rule p < 0.05 and at least 2-fold. No correction for multiple testing across the 58 genes compared. Analysis: as decided (which control genes to normalise to: Top three by stability (ALUsq(Eurogentec), HPRT1, HMBS)).
